name: dsh-sovereign
description: Host-plane sovereignty clause and content guard for DSH: a prompt section placed last in the system prompt, plus tool-result sanitization, a reversibility gate, and a live feature switch that takes effect on the next model request. Applies to every agent preset, not one.
